description: Watches only fa-icons: a new vX.Y.Z tag on m-kolovrat/fa-icons opens a PR that bumps it here. Other dependencies are updated by hand. See docs/icons.md.

prBodyNotes: Release notes: https://github.com/m-kolovrat/fa-icons/releases. Check the stories that use a changed asset before merging (`npm run storybook`).

packageRules.description: A major fa-icons release renames or removes assets: fix the imports on this PR before merging.
prBodyNotes: **Major release:** assets were renamed or removed. `npm test` fails on imports that no longer exist; fix them on this branch.
